    • Solutions

      Serverfarm delivers scalable, AI-ready, and build-to-suit data centers with high-density power, liquid cooling, and sustainable design for efficient, high-performance digital infrastructure deployment.

      AI-ML Data Centers

      AI-ready, high-density data centers with liquid cooling, scalable power, & sustainable infrastructure in key markets.

      Build-to-Suit Data Centers

      Build-to-suit data center solutions with scalable, efficient infrastructure in key global metro locations.

      Data Center Campus

      Scalable data center campuses to support AI, cloud, & enterprise growth with flexible & sustainable infrastructure.

Help Shape the Future of Data Centers

At Serverfarm, we need dedicated, highly motivated self-starters to join our mission in building the next generation of critical infrastructure. With over ten data center locations worldwide, we’re looking for those with passion, drive, and dedication for our company to continue to scale and better serve our customers.

We strive to deliver an environment that offers challenging, stimulating and financially rewarding opportunities. We champion creativity, innovation and welcome diverse ideas with enthusiasm.

The potential for Serverfarm to continue to expand is ongoing, which means more opportunities for our team members here to grow in their roles.

View Open Positions

Our Core Values

Adaptability

Adapt. Communicate. Grow.
We respond to change with flexibility, resilience, and clear communication, turning challenges into opportunities for growth and improvement.

Integrity

Own. Protect. Deliver.
We take accountability for our actions, act with honesty, protect people and systems, and follow through on commitments the right way.

Innovation

Improve. Learn. Evolve.
We continuously seek better ways to work by learning, improving processes, sharing knowledge, and embracing new ideas that drive progress. 

Teamwork

Collaborate. Support. Succeed. 
We work together with respect and shared purpose, supporting one another and prioritizing collective success over individual recognition. 

Kickstart Your Career at Serverfarm

Serverfarm’s internship program gives university students hands-on experience working on real projects across our global data center operations. Through mentorship, leadership development, and collaboration with teams across the company, interns gain valuable industry experience, build professional skills, and explore career opportunities in the growing data center industry.

 
Innovation starts with people. That's why we're committed to creating an environment where every employee can do their best work and build a rewarding career.
Maria Rodriguez
Chief People Officer
